hooks.description: When a new source file is created, append a short dated entry to docs/devlog.md so the build history writes itself. This log becomes the raw material for the hackathon 'How we used Kiro' write-up.
hooks.name: dev-log-keeper

then.prompt: A new source file was just created in this project. Append ONE concise entry to docs/devlog.md under today's date: what the file is and which spec (retro-ui, chat-window, ai-buddies, log-resurrection) it belongs to. Keep it to 1-2 lines, factual, no fluff. Do not rewrite or reformat earlier entries.
